title: feat(types)!: DetailViewFieldSchema.options reads the spec's authoring SelectOptionSchema (#7759 group F)
body:
Closes #10296
Part of #7759
Clause-②: yes

## What this does

`views.zod.ts#DetailViewFieldSchema.options` now reads the spec's AUTHORING `SelectOptionSchema` (`@objectstack/spec/data`) by reference, wrapped in `stripImportedDefaults` like every other crossing. That follows ruling F1 on objectui#7759 (5617221514, adopted in 5617465269): a structural mirror points at the spec's authoring schema, ⛔ never at the declaration's runtime read model (`SelectOptionMetadata`). The TypeScript declaration is unchanged.

Before: an inline option shape. It admitted a number or boolean `value`, which the declaration refuses, and silently stripped every other key.
After: the spec's strict schema. `value` must be a machine identifier. `icon` and `disabled` are refused by name (`unrecognized_keys`). `description`, `default` and `visibleWhen` are accepted as the spec declares them.

## Re-derived population (origin/main `8b1f06619`, `WIDER_ARMS`, CONCRETE rows only)

Sibling branches were fetched into private refs, and each row was checked for whether it disappears there.

| `FilterBuilderSchema::fields`, `FilterFieldSchema::operators`, `ContainerSchema::maxWidth`, `HeaderBarSchema::variant` | C/D | objectui#10286 (all four gone on its branch) | excluded |

`ChatbotSchema.body` is already settled on `main`. objectui#8572 (PR #9639) retired it on both faces as a `?: never` tombstone, and the row left the ledger. Nothing is left to do for it here.

## The ledger reading: an expected divergence, not a zero

After the mirror points at the authoring schema, the two faces differ on exactly one member: `visibleWhen`. The spec's input envelope requires `dialect`. The read model's wire (objectui#2212) makes `dialect` optional and `source` required. Measured with `tsc`, this is the only incompatibility. `label`, `value` and the whole-object check agree otherwise.

- ⛔ I did not override `visibleWhen` locally to reach a zero-row ledger. That would narrow and widen a spec-declared shape inside objectui, which the ordering note 5617614225 forbids.
- The row stays in `WiderThanDeclared` and `WIDER_ARMS`, re-annotated as EXPECTED DIVERGENCE (read model). The old reason, the inline shape, is gone.
- `KnownDrift` gains `DetailViewFieldSchema: 'options'`. The same cause is measured one level up, so it also gains `DetailViewSectionSchema: 'fields'` (new entry), and `DetailViewSchema` gains `fields` and `sections`. The header figures were re-derived to 48 entries / 89 keys. The restated figure under "KNOWN_DRIFT is a ratchet" was updated too.
- `SPEC_DERIVED_PAIRS` gains `views.zod.ts#DetailViewFieldSchema`, because the census test derived it from the source.

## Evidence (HEAD `a8446a2ae`)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` (all three tsconfigs): exit 0. `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/` gave `Test Files 215 passed (215)` and `Tests 4929 passed (4929)`. These ran under the verify lock, on bytes identical to the commit.
- New pin `packages/types/src/__tests__/detail-view-field-options-10296.test.ts`: 6 tests. It asserts `code` and `path` for each refusal, next to an accepting control, plus verdict parity with the spec schema.
- Reverse verification (committed first, trap-guarded): I restored the mirror file from the base commit. The inline marker count was 1 and the spec-reference count was 0. Results: the pin gave `5 failed | 1 passed (6)` (the accepting control stays green), and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` failed with exit 2 on `LedgerMismatch` naming `views.zod.ts#DetailViewFieldSchema`. After `git checkout HEAD -- FILE`: `git diff HEAD` was 0 bytes and the blob hash matched HEAD.
- Downstream: built the closure of `@object-ui/plugin-detail` (turbo, 11 tasks). `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check` exit 0. Its two tests that import the zod `DetailViewSchema` / `DetailViewSectionSchema` passed: `2 passed`, `21 passed`.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the 3 changed source files: `--format json` gave 3 files, 0 errors, and 2 warnings on lines this diff does not touch. Type-aware linting is not configured, so the diff cannot move any verdict on an untouched file.
- `check-changeset-presence`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:installed-pin-claims`: all exit 0.
- `check:spec-floors`: NOT MEASURED. It needs a whole-workspace build (`no-artifact`), so it is left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- `DashboardComponentSchema::dateRange`: STOP, because it sits in PR objectui#10273's excluded region. For whoever takes it: `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0 exports `DATE_RANGE_DEFAULT_RANGES` / `DateRangeDefaultRange` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`, so rule 1 likely applies (the mirror takes the spec's vocabulary). That is not measured here.
- `HeaderBarSchema::logo`: STOP, because it sits in objectui#10286's `HeaderBar` region. Proposal F routed it to ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove together with `variant`.
- A reviewer can reopen the choice between recording `visibleWhen` as an expected divergence (this PR) and overriding it with objectui's wire, which would give a zero-row ledger but a local reshaping of a spec-declared key.
